name: Loan For Foreign Study (S.E.B.C.)
benefit:
##### ***Financial Assistance***

- A maximum Foreign Study Loan of ₹15,00,000/- is provided for higher education abroad.
- The loan is offered at a simple annual interest rate of 4%.
- The loan covers costs such as air tickets, registration fees, tuition fees, education fees, hostel fees, books, and other expenses associated with the first year of the course abroad.

##### ***Disbursement Conditi
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (S.E.B.C.). - The applicant's family annual income must be less than ₹10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten Lakh). - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 60% or more marks in 12th standard. - The applicant must have secured a minimum of 50% marks if they belong to Notified Tribes/De-notified Tribes (NT/DNT), More Backward, or Extremely Backward categories. - The applicant must be pursuing higher education abroad. - The applicant must be pursuing a Diploma, Graduate, Post Graduate, Post Graduate Diploma, Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.), or higher-level courses in any field. - The course must be for a minimum duration of 1 (one) academic year or more, or at least two semesters. - The applicant must apply before traveling abroad or within six months of arriving abroad. - The applicant must submit one solvent guarantor.
